name: microblog
description: A regular Hugo version of the blog exported from Micro.blog.

scripts.build: node scripts/generate-netlify-redirects.mjs && node scripts/generate-image-derivatives.mjs && hugo --gc --minify && node scripts/remove-public-alias-files.mjs && pagefind --site public
scripts.dev: hugo --quiet -d .pagefind-build && pagefind --site .pagefind-build --output-path static/pagefind && rm -rf .pagefind-build && hugo server
